title: Transition table decomposition
statement: Let $M$ be a machine in code normal form, let $q$ be one of its states, and let $u,w$ each be a blank symbol or a bit. The canonical serialization of $M$ consists of its header, followed by the serialized records of a list of exactly $q$ groups, each containing nine actions, followed by the serialized records of a list of actions whose length is the index of the read pair $(u,w)$, then the record for the action prescribed by $M$ in state $q$ on reads $(u,w)$, and finally a remaining bit string.
replaced:
For every coded machine $M$, state $q$ of $M$, and pair of reads (an input
symbol and a work symbol, each blank, $0$, or $1$), the canonical
serialization of $M$ decomposes as: the header, then the concatenated
serialized records of a list of exactly $q$ groups of nine actions each
(the full groups of the states preceding $q$), then the concatenated
serialized records of a list of actions whose length is the record index of
the read pair, then the serialized record of the action $M$ performs at $q$
on those reads, then a remainder.
